newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner wins NOK 1 bln ship contract.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner wins NOK 1 bln ship contract.

text.p: Norwegian engineering and construction group Kvaerner ASA said on Tuesday its Kvaerner Floro shipyard had won an order for two chemical tankers from Norway's Storli ASA.
The contract was valued at one billion crowns, Kvaerner said.
Storli also has an option for two further vessels, which would provide work for the yard until the year 2000.

Kvaerner said the two new 37,500 tonne chemical tankers will secure full capacity at Floro until 1999, and brings the total number of vessels built by Kvaerner Floro for Storli and its partner National Chemical Carriers of Saudi Arabia to 10.

"This is an important shipbuilding order for Norwegian yards and demonstrates the significant benefit to the industry of having major ship-owning companies with their prime offices in Norway," said Bjoern Lillelien, president of Kvaerner Floro.
